subtitulo.en: For complete beginners: how Spanish letters sound and how to read Spanish.

tarjeta.en: Starting from zero? How Spanish letters sound and how to read them.

junta.en: Listen slowly, then fast: that's how you read Spanish.

mapaIntro.en: Spanish is easy to read: almost every letter has one sound, and the five vowels never change. A few letters surprise English speakers (h, j, ll, ñ, r, rr, v, g). Each sound has a picture and a color, and you'll see them in the words. Tap a card to hear it.

nota: Marcado: (letras:sonido) pinta las letras con el color del sonido (ver sonidos.json); _ = muda (h, u de gue/gui/que/qui). Fuente: tools/contenido/nivel0-es/ (borradores) → integrar.py. Apoyo solo en inglés.
